build.buildCommand: set -e; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgl1 libglib2.0-0; PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; echo "building with $PY -> $($PY --version 2>&1)"; cd backend; "$PY" -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; "$PY" -m pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu; "$PY" -m pip install -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: cd backend && "$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
